title: Land set aside for the desert tortoise
text: The Desert Tortoise Research Natural Area covers 39.5 square miles of the western Mojave Desert. It was set aside to protect the desert tortoise, which is California's state reptile. In 1980, the Bureau of Land Management designated it an Area of Critical Environmental Concern and a Research Natural Area. The area is fenced, and an interpretive center there was dedicated in April 1980.
